nodes.summary: For a type $X$ and $p \in [0, 1]$, the binomial random subset distribution on $X$ with parameter $p$ is the probability measure on the subsets of $X$ under which each element of $X$ belongs to the random subset independently with probability $p$. A random subset with this law is denoted $X_p$.
nodes.title: Binomial random subset

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a finite type and $p \in [0, 1]$. A family $\mathcal{F}$ of subsets of $X$ is $p$-small when there is a family $\mathcal{G}$ of subsets of $X$ such that every member of $\mathcal{F}$ contains some member of $\mathcal{G}$ and $\sum_{S \in \mathcal{G}} p^{|S|} \le 1/2$.
nodes.title: $p$-small families of sets

nodes.summary: Given random variables $Y_1, \dots, Y_N$ on $\Omega$ with values in $\mathbb{T}$ and a function $f : \mathbb{T} \to [0, \infty)$, $Z_N(f)$ is the random variable $Z_N(f)(\omega) = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} f(Y_i(\omega))$, which is $0$ when $N = 0$.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
